metadata.title: GovRAMP Low with Federal (FedRAMP Rev. 5) alignment overlay
metadata.remarks: Chained on govramp-low, with the overlay tabs low applied in that order (the workbook states that each level includes the lower levels' deltas). Adds controls FedRAMP requires that GovRAMP does not select, sets the overlay parameter where FedRAMP is the higher watermark, and attaches FedRAMP requirements and guidance. Generated by Oscalis from GovRAMP workbooks (GovRAMP Federal Overlay.xlsx). Control membership, parameter values and additional requirements are GovRAMP's. Parameter text was mapped onto NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 parameter ids by src/scripts/import_govramp.py; entries that could not be placed safely are kept as 'parameter-text' notes. NIST control text comes from the NIST catalog, not from the workbooks.

values: a time period in compliance with M-21-31

parts.name: federal-requirement
parts.prose:
The service provider retains audit records on-line for at least ninety days and further preserves audit records off-line for a period that is in accordance with NARA requirements.

The service provider must support Agency requirements to comply with M-21-31 (https://www.whitehouse.gov/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/M-21-31-Improving-the-Federal-Governments-Investigative-and-Remediation-Capabilities-Related-to-Cybersecurity-Incidents.pdf)

parts.name: federal-guidance
parts.prose: The service provider is encouraged to align with M-21-31 where possible

parts.name: federal-guidance
parts.prose: Significant change is defined in NIST Special Publication 800-37 Revision 2, Appendix F and according to FedRAMP Significant Change Policies and Procedures. The service provider describes the types of changes to the information system or the environment of operations that would impact the risk posture. The types of changes are approved and accepted by the JAB/AO.
